description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shinsect Riot Style, Point-Blank Shot, proficiency with 1-handed firearms, 3 ranks in Intimidate or 3 ranks in Bluff

Benefit: When in Shinsect Riot Style and wielding a 1-handed firearm, you gain the benefits of the Ranged Feint feat. However, instead of feinting, you can also choose to demoralize a target creature as long as you are within the first range increment of your firearm.

system.requirements: Shinsect Riot Style, Point-Blank Shot, proficiency with 1-handed firearms, 3 ranks in Intimidate or 3 ranks in Bluff
